text:
Anya: Weekend poll — thinking of hitting the corgi parade downtown on Sunday morning 🐶 OR the vintage music & vinyl fair on Saturday (indoor) 🎶. Also maybe swing by the farmers' market after. Who's in?
Mike: Ooh corgi parade! Need to see pups in tiny sweaters :heart_eyes:
Sam: Vinyl fair for me — got a list of records to hunt. Also indoor = no rain risk.
Jordan: If it's sunny, farmers' market + picnic sounds perfect. Corgis would be a plus.
Anya: @Sam where's the vinyl fair? link?
OpsBot: Reminder: company picnic sign-up closes Friday at 5pm! :calendar:
Mike: lol OpsBot stealing our weekend planning bandwidth :laughing:
Sam: https://localvinyl.example.com — stalls 10–4, small entry fee. Coffee nearby.
Jordan: Vote: corgi parade (🐶), vinyl fair (🎶), farmers' market picnic (🥐). I'll tally.
Mike: corgi !!
Anya: vinyl 🎶
Sam: farmers' market picnic 🥐
Jordan: tally: corgi 1, vinyl 1, picnic 1 — looks like a three-way tie. :stuck_out_tongue:
Mike: Anyone want to meetup after? 11:30 near the fountain?
Anya: Count me in for 11:30 if corgi or picnic.
Sam: Maybe for the picnic — I'll bring a portable speaker for vinyl samples :metal:
Jordan: I'll bring extra folding chairs.
Anya: Sweet. @Mike can you create a quick thread in #lunch-plans for logistics?
Mike: done — posted in #lunch-plans :thumbsup:
